items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year but still well below all-time highs; supply and demand trends appear poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in electric vehicles and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges.
